meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native workflow tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一次调用让多个AI助手按依赖关系协同作业
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有需要分步完成、且步骤间有先后依赖的复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent AI subtasks together in a single workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big task that can be split into dependent subtasks.

howto.what: Claude 会把复杂任务拆成多个有依赖关系的子任务，交给子代理并行执行，前序任务完成后才启动后续任务，最后按证据验证结果是否达标。
howto.when: 当你说出 “mass-ulw”、要求按依赖关系执行一组任务（如扇出/扇入），或提出需要多代理按顺序协作时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 跑一个 DAG：先审计文档，再重写，最后验证。
say.note: Claude 会按依赖顺序编排这三个子任务。

say.text: 请把 A 和 B 并行执行，都完成后再做 C。
say.note: Claude 会建立依赖关系并等待 A、B 完成。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 安排这几个任务，前一步完成后才能进行下一步。
say.note: Claude 会定义依赖图并执行。

howto.what_en: Claude will break a complex request into dependent subtasks, dispatch them to child agents in parallel, start downstream tasks only after prerequisites finish, and verify results against captured evidence at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks depend on others.

say_en.text: Run a DAG with mass-ulw: audit docs first, then rewrite, then verify.
say_en.note: Claude will orchestrate the three subtasks in dependency order.

say_en.text: Run A and B in parallel, then C after both finish.
say_en.note: Claude sets up the dependency and waits for A and B.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to schedule these tasks so each step waits for the previous one.
say_en.note: Claude defines the dependency graph and executes it.
